skill.name: mlops-engineer
skill.description: Build comprehensive ML pipelines, experiment tracking, and model registries with MLflow, Kubeflow, and modern MLOps tools. Implements automated training, deployment, and monitoring across cloud platforms. Use PROACTIVELY for ML infrastructure, experiment management, or pipeline automation.
skill.summary: Design production MLOps pipelines, model registries, deployment workflows, and monitoring systems.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: ML teams need reliable paths from experiments to production. This skill guides pipelines, registries, deployment automation, and monitoring across modern MLOps stacks.
actual_capabilities: Designs ML pipeline architectures using Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, and cloud-native workflow tools.
Guides experiment tracking and model registry workflows with MLflow, Weights and Biases, DVC, and cloud registries.
Plans model deployment patterns for batch, real-time, serverless, canary, and blue-green releases.
Recommends monitoring for drift, data quality, model performance, infrastructure health, and cost control.
Connects MLOps workflows to Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, GitOps, and secrets management.
Addresses governance needs such as lineage, approval gates, audit trails, and compliance controls.
limitations: It provides architecture guidance and implementation plans, not direct access to cloud accounts or clusters.
It cannot validate real model performance without your metrics, datasets, and production telemetry.
Tool recommendations depend on the requirements and constraints supplied in the prompt.
Security and compliance advice should be reviewed against your organization policies.

use_cases.title: Design a Cloud MLOps Platform
use_cases.description: Plan a complete platform for training, registry workflows, deployment, monitoring, and governance on one cloud provider.

use_cases.title: Automate Model Promotion
use_cases.description: Create approval gates, validation checks, registry stages, and rollback plans for controlled model releases.

use_cases.title: Improve Production Observability
use_cases.description: Define drift detection, data quality checks, service metrics, alerts, dashboards, and cost monitoring for ML systems.

prompt_templates.title: Start an MLOps Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design an MLOps plan for a model that trains weekly and serves real-time predictions. Include tools, stages, and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Pipeline Tools
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, and managed cloud pipelines for our ML workflow. Recommend one based on team size and Kubernetes experience.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Release Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a model release workflow with experiment tracking, registry stages, validation checks, canary deployment, monitoring, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Design Regulated MLOps
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a HIPAA-ready MLOps platform with lineage, access control, secrets management, audit trails, drift monitoring, and disaster recovery.

output_examples.input: Design an AWS MLOps platform for automated retraining and deployment.
output: Reference architecture covering SageMaker Pipelines, S3, Model Registry, ECR, IAM, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
Training, validation, approval, deployment, monitoring, and rollback stages with clear ownership.
Security controls for least privilege, encryption, network boundaries, secrets, and audit logs.

output_examples.input: Help detect drift and model degradation in production.
output: Monitoring plan for input drift, prediction distribution changes, data quality, latency, errors, and business metrics.
Alert thresholds, dashboard sections, response steps, and retraining triggers.
Recommendations for tools such as Evidently, Prometheus, Grafana, and cloud monitoring services.

output_examples.input: Create a GitOps workflow for model deployment.
output: Branching, registry promotion, manifest updates, review gates, and deployment automation steps.
Canary and rollback plan tied to model quality, service health, and operational metrics.
Checklist for reproducibility, approvals, artifact traceability, and environment parity.

best_practices: Share cloud provider, compliance requirements, expected scale, data sensitivity, and team operating model.
Ask for validation gates, rollback plans, monitoring metrics, and ownership boundaries in every production workflow.
Review generated infrastructure and deployment plans with security, platform, and data governance teams.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy models without registry metadata, approval history, or rollback criteria.
Do not mix training, serving, and monitoring credentials without clear access boundaries.
Do not choose orchestration tools before defining workflow scale, ownership, and operational constraints.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design ML pipelines, experiment tracking, model registries, deployment workflows, monitoring, and governance processes.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, DVC, and related MLOps tools.

faq.question: Can it generate production-ready infrastructure?
faq.answer: It can guide infrastructure design and implementation steps, but engineers must test and adapt generated artifacts before production use.

faq.question: Does it support regulated environments?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for access control, encryption, lineage, audit trails, approval gates, and compliance-aware operations.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Provide model type, data sources, cloud provider, deployment targets, scale, latency goals, compliance needs, and existing tools.

faq.question: Can it replace an MLOps team?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and implementation work, but experienced engineers must own production decisions and operations.
